name: Replication errors over time
description: Failure observations grouped by naming context, DC or site. Missing intervals are filled with zero; groups without any observations are omitted.
kql:
let StartTime = ago(_TimePeriod);
let EndTime = now();
DCReplicationData_CL
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated >= StartTime and TimeGenerated < EndTime
| extend Series = case(
    _GroupBy == "NC", tostring(NC),
    _GroupBy == "DestDSA", tostring(DestDSA),
    _GroupBy == "SourceDSASite", tostring(SourceDSASite),
    _GroupBy == "DestDSASite", tostring(DestDSASite),
    tostring(SourceDSA))
| make-series Value = countif(toint(NumberOfFailures) > 0)
    default=0
    on TimeGenerated
    from StartTime to EndTime step _BinSize
    by Series
| mv-expand
    Timestamp = TimeGenerated to typeof(datetime),
    Value to typeof(long)
| project Timestamp, Series, Value
| order by Timestamp asc, Series asc
